ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Sangam (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Acquisition — Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

Allotment of Securities — Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 1800000 warrants convertible into equal number of equity shares of the face value of Rs. 10/- each on a preferential basis on September 11, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sangam (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations —  Ram Pal Soni has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

Resignation — Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Mr. Sudhir Maheshwari , Non Executive and Independent Director, has tendered his resignation from the Board of Directors of the company with effect from the close of the business hours on 04th May, 2026
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sangam (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Change in Management — Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Re-appointment of Cost Auditors and Internal Auditors for the Financial Year 2026-27.
Updates — Sangam (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Acquisition'
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sangam (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025.
